description: Resolves what CSS actually applies to a given selector. Returns every property the selector would receive, which rule wins for each property, and which rules were overridden — with confidence levels (certain/likely/possible) since no real DOM is available. Call this before modifying styles for an element to understand the full cascade context first.

componentFiles.description: Optional: absolute paths to JSX/TSX files. When provided, builds an AST component graph to upgrade selector confidence from possible to likely where ancestry is confirmed.

files.description: Absolute paths to CSS/SCSS files to analyze.

projectRoot.description: Optional: path to a project root. All CSS/SCSS files will be discovered recursively.

selector.description: CSS selector to resolve, e.g. ".btn.primary", "#header a:hover"

name: resolve_styles
